concept:
AXI SELECT 2/6 · «(2) مرحلة Incubation»: THE RULES OF THE INCUBATOR. Video 2 is the same brand world as video 1 v2: pure black, Axi red #E4002E as the only accent, white and greys, metallic numerals, TAG plates and chamfered cards, the ◢ texture, ▲▲▲, the red flag and the official logo PNGs. It uses the same studio (the L4 virtual camera and floor light) and the same kit.

The video tells one chain:
- you are now in stage 2;
- one rule comes before anything: withdraw only before your first trade, in every stage;
- how you got in: Edge Score 60+ and $1,000+;
- what Axi gives: x10, so $1,000 → $10,000 and $2,000 → $20,000 (the Incubation cap);
- what you must do: four conditions that build a checklist (40 trades, +7%, never −10%, 60 days from the first trade);
- where it leads: the flag climbs from stage 2 to Acceleration, and next comes video (3);
- the reward: «مبروك!» and a 40% profit share in the Axi Select account.

Symbols
- Fixed across the series: CANDLES = your trading account, VAULT = Axi's allocation account, DOME = Incubation (stage 2), CHEV = Acceleration (stage 3), the red flag marker = you.
- New in video 2:
  - TICKETS (40 trades), TARGET (+7%), SHIELD (the limit, from video 1), CALENDAR (60 days);
  - the RULE MARK: an open white segment, then a RED first-trade tick, then the rest dimmed (open window → first trade → locked). It is B-roll 1's withdrawal timeline in miniature, and D stamps it on every stage's landing;
  - the FIRST-TRADE chip. It is the moment the withdrawal window closes and the moment the 60-day clock starts, so it appears in B-roll 1 and again in the 60-day beat, tying the rule to the condition;
  - the four CONDITION PIPS: seeded in A, lit one per condition shot (J, L, M), ticked DONE as the recap in M, and carried, all DONE, into N;
  - the DONUT (the 40% share), with your 40% on the side facing the profit flow.
- The ▲▲▲ brand mark only ever sits beside a rising numeral. The CHEV stage symbol is used only for Acceleration.

Two full-screen B-rolls with hard cuts (client note 1)
- B-roll 1, «نافذة السحب» (output 0:10.72-0:17.72): a stage timeline whose withdrawal window is open until the first-trade chip lands, then locks with a padlock.
- B-roll 2, «x10» (output 0:37.04-0:48.04): a multiplier gate turns your account's $1,000 block into ten blocks ($10,000), then $2,000 into twenty. The total is left for the next shot, where Rabee says it.

In the studio
- the official lockup in the void (A);
- the six-stage staircase twice: in D every landing gets the rule mark as a red comet climbs it, and in N the set is already standing and the flag climbs from Incubation to Acceleration;
- the page-8 'x10' hero over his head (G), cut in on DROP 1;
- the dashed red limit ring on the floor (L), with an equity line that dips toward −10% and recovers;
- a WIDE → HOME push that ends on the official logo inside the Axi Select account card (Q).

Music (built: W2 work/audio_build.py, audio/music_plan.json)
- DROP 1 at output 33.00 = VO 32.37: the smash cut F → G into the funding section, in the pause before «ستقوم».
- A quiet break bar under «في الفيديو القادم» (output 74.45-76.64 = VO 73.82-76.01).
- DROP 2 at output 76.64, its boom at output 76.69 = VO 76.06: the cut O → P into «مبروك!».
- The track's own ending hit at output 85.36: the end card's logo build.
- The picture follows the mix; the mix is not rebuilt.

Rules carried over from video 1's QA
- Nothing covers him, the subtitle band or the bug zone.
- Exits end at least 2 frames before every cut or camera move.
- One flag per scene.
- Arabic clips reach baseline + 0.6 em.
- Hits land on measured onsets (see word_onsets: whisper ran 0.1-0.7 s early).
- SFX sit in measured pauses; nothing transient lands on a word that carries meaning (the cue lists use the audio_build categories).
- Red floor marks are crisp decals, and soft pools are white.
- One fading layer per group.
- No sheen on the white logos or on white type.

Timing (the soundtrack is already built for this; the draft's P = 1.06 is superseded)
- output = VO + P with P = 0.63, 25 fps, END 91.00 s = 2275 frames.
- Title card output 0.00-3.00 (frames 0-75) = up to VO 2.37. Speech starts at VO 2.43 (output 3.06), so HOME holds Rabee 0.06 s before «مرحباً».
- The last word «Select» ends at VO 84.01-84.02. End wipe VO 84.09-84.61 (output 84.72-85.24, frames 2118-2131); end card output 85.24-91.00 (frames 2131-2275).
- With P = 0.63 the frame grid in VO is 0.01 + 0.04n. Every cut sits on it, inside a measured pause (W2 work/vo_pauses_vo.json). The one exception is O → P at 76.05, on the last −40 dB frame of «القادم», so that the drop's boom lands on P's first frame.
design_system:
SAME AS VIDEO 1 v2: palette, type, the measured brand marks (1)-(17), layout and keep-outs, camera, motion and performance, exactly as in SC/sel/mg_final_design_system.txt. Where the delivered video 1 code differs from that text, the CODE wins:
- the pure #000 MG pages;
- the staircase geometry in W1 comp/src/32_stages.js (st_LX [1540,1300,1060,820,580,340], st_LY [742,642,542,442,342,242], cards 230x88, ground to x 1780);
- the end-card timing structure in 30_open.js op_end;
- 90_main's end wipe (a #000 panel with the '/' edge over V/Q held at full opacity).

ONLY WHAT DIFFERS IN VIDEO 2

1. Black (client note 5)
   - Every MG page is pure #000000: title card, both B-rolls, the end wipe and the end card.
   - No INK #0B0C0E base and no radial lift: the mg_final.json text for the title, B-roll and end card is superseded.
   - Light comes only from designed elements: the ◢ texture, bokeh, haze, logo and type.

2. Floor
   - Soft pools are WHITE only: the base pool .18, a lift to .26 on hero landings, and an inner pool of .12 inside rings.
   - Red on the floor is only a crisp decal: pad rim, ripple, stage pulse, limit ring (ringq), ◢ field.
   - Video 1's red pool under the stool in D is not repeated.

3. Timeline
   - output = VO + 0.63 (P), the value the built soundtrack uses. Title card output 0.00-3.00.
   - End wipe VO 84.09-84.61; end card output 85.24-91.00.
   - Total 91.00 s (2275 frames).
   - Cuts at VO 0.01 + 0.04n (exact frames).

4. Bug
   - On over VO 8.81-77.21 on presenter shots: switched on at the A → B cut and off at the P → Q cut, never mid-shot.
   - Off in the title card, in A (the lockup is in the void), in both B-rolls (VO 10.09-17.09 and 36.41-47.41), in all of Q (the official logo builds in the account card there, and Q mirrors A) and on the end card.
   - 90_main must read the window from k_t (kit_additions K11).

5. Arabic clip rule
   - Every per-word reveal clip extends from baseline − 1.25 em to baseline + 0.70 em.
   - The kit's headline() already does this. Video 1's op_words clip stops at + 0.45 em and must be widened wherever it is copied.

6. Condition pips (new system; kit pips(), K7)
   - Four TAG plates read right to left: 1 TICKETS (40 trades), 2 TARGET (+7%), 3 SHIELD (never −10%), 4 CALENDAR (60 days).
   - Minimum size 72x48 (30 px symbols); A uses 112x72.
   - States:
     - DIM: no fill, outline white .25, symbol DIM;
     - LIT: PANEL, RED rim 1.5 px, symbol white + red;
     - DONE: fill .7, outline white .25, symbol white .8 (its red element too), the top-left cut RED with a white tick.
   - Sequence: A shows all four DIM. J: 1 LIT, turning DONE on '40+' (54.01). K shows no pips (it is a 2.4 s close-up). L: 1-2 DONE + 3 LIT. M: 1-3 DONE + 4 LIT; 4 turns DONE on «تحقيق» (66.43) and the four pulse right to left: that is the recap. N: all four DONE in the readout from the cut, one pulse on «مؤهّلاً» (68.07).

7. Counters
   - Every counter uses the kit's metalCount() in fixed final slots. It lands on the measured onset of the spoken number (word_onsets): 60 27.48, $1,000 31.71, $1,000 38.01, $10,000 40.75, $2,000 43.32, $20,000 49.30, 40 52.68, 60 63.31, 40% 79.44. ('7%' and '−10%' land as static numerals on 56.23 and 59.20.)
   - Numbers he does not say are static (the '$100,000' Acceleration cap), or not shown at all (the 60% Axi remainder, and the B-roll-2 total before he says it).

8. ▲▲▲ placements in video 2: beside 'x10' (G), '$10,000' (B-roll 2), '$20,000' (I), '7%' (K) and '40%' (Q). Never beside a threshold ('60+' in E, '40+' in J) or a limit ('−10%' in L). The full stagger (3 × 0.08 s + 0.3 s = 0.54 s) must finish before the exit.

9. Multiplier numerals
   - 'x10' uses a Latin x in metal() (natural advance).
   - In equations the multiplication sign is a RED '×' (U+00D7) in Inter 300.

10. Footnote under '−10%' (L): «* قد تختلف النسبة حسب المرحلة» / «وفق شروط البرنامج», A300 34 grey α .85, on screen ≥ 2.2 s. axi.com lists −7% max loss for Incubation, and Rabee says 10%: keep his words plus this footnote.

11. Measured widths
   - Every width in this spec is what the renderer draws: Chromium 153 canvas measureText with the project fonts at the stated weight and size (W2 comp/fonts alex_ar.woff2, alex_lat.woff2, inter.ttf, loaded with FontFace weight '100 900' exactly as engine.js loadFonts does; tool /home/user/rr/ep2-director/measure.js). Metal widths follow metalLayout.
   - inter.ttf is variable with an opsz axis (14-32), and Chromium canvas applies optical sizing automatically: opsz = font size, clamped to 32. Text-shaping tools at the default opsz 14 (HarfBuzz, FreeType, a DOM span with font-optical-sizing:none) measure Inter 6-10 % wider than the render: 'Incubation' I300 110 is 488 in the canvas and 537 at opsz 14; 'Acceleration' I400 26 is 146 / 155; 'Edge Score' I300 40 is 198 / 213. Never re-anchor from such a tool. Builders fit-check with measure() and metalWidth() at init.

12. Money strings in metal() and metalCount()
   - Always pass them without a space: '$1,000', '$2,000', '$10,000', '$20,000', '$100,000' (fmtMoney style). metalLayout already adds 0.2 em after a full-size '$'; an ASCII space would add a 0.28 em cell on top.

13. The RULE MARK (D, and the readout glyph)
   - On a landing read from its right end (where you step on): a 5 px white α 1 segment (open window), a RED 3x22 tick (first trade), then the rest of the landing dimmed to white .25 (locked).
   - In text it is a glyph: a 24x5 white bar with a 3x14 RED tick at its left end.

14. SFX are written as 'category gain_db @ VO time (note)' with the audio_build categories (boom, buzz, corrupt, crack, dataswish, flash, glitch, hit, longwhoosh, powerdown, poweron, riser, scan, static, type, ui_blip, ui_error, whoosh). Transients (hit, flash, boom, crack, glitch, ui_error, ui_blip, type) only go in measured pauses. The two drops' booms are in the mix already, and no group adds a boom.

Whisper (clean_large.json) ran 0.1-0.7 s EARLY throughout, worst at segment starts: «مرحباً» 1.94 → 2.43, «ستقوم» 32.17 → 32.40, «Select» end 83.35 → 84.02. Values are VO seconds; [a-b] = real pause (below −48 dBFS) where SFX go. The authoritative pause map for cuts and SFX is W2 work/vo_pauses_vo.json (−42 dBFS, ≥ 80 ms), the one audio_build.py uses. kit_additions.name: pips(x, Xr, Y, w, h, pitch, st, o)
kit_additions.spec:
The four CONDITION PIPS.
- TAG plates right to left: pip i (0..3) at X = Xr − w − i·pitch, size w x h. Minimum size 72x48 (30 px symbols).
- Symbols [tickets, target, shield, calendar] at 0.62h, centred.
- st[i] = { s: 'dim' | 'lit' | 'done', u: 0..1 (progress into s, from the previous state), pulse: 0..1 }.
  - dim: no fill, outline white .25, symbol DIM;
  - lit: PANEL fill, RED rim 1.5 px, symbol white + red, plus an optional pulse (scale 1 + .08 sin(πp));
  - done: fill .7, outline white .25, symbol white α .8 including its red element, top-left cut RED with a white tick (tag() o.done = u).
- Transitions are a 0.25 s cross-fade driven by st.u (e3):
  - DIM → LIT: rim white .25 → RED; fill 0 → PANEL .96; symbol DIM → white with its red element.
  - LIT → DONE: fill .96 → .7; rim RED → white .25; the symbol's red element → white .8; tag() o.done = u draws the red cut and tick.
  - Pulses are independent of the state and can run in any state.
- o.a: group alpha (fade one layer).
- o.shimmer 0..1: one white α .12 band, 80 px, 20°, sweeping right to left over the row (source-atop on an offscreen copy, as withSheen). Used only in A, on DIM pips.
- o.enter 0..1: per-pip staggered entry (0.08 s RTL, 16 px rise, expo).

kit_additions.name: metalCount(x, value, fin, X, Y, size, o)
kit_additions.spec:
Video 1's st_count, generalized.
- fin is the final string, always WITHOUT a space after '$' ('$1,000', '$10,000', '$2,000', '$20,000', '60', '40', '40%'): metalLayout already adds 0.2 em after a full-size '$', and an ASCII space would add a 0.28 em cell on top. The prose may write '$ 1,000' as notation; code never does.
- Split fin into a prefix (everything before the first digit: '$' or nothing), a body (digits and commas) and a suffix (after the last digit: '%').
- L = metalLayout(fin, size, w); slot = the centre of each body glyph in L.
- The current body is Math.round(value), formatted with commas if fin's body has commas. Its glyphs are drawn right-aligned into the final body's slots, each centred on its slot. The prefix and suffix are drawn at their final positions.
- When Math.round(value) equals the final number, it draws metal(x, fin, …) (static, natural advances, with o.sheen), so the landed frame never moves.
- o: w (200), align (left | center | right), a, fade (bottom 28 %, heroes ≥ 150 px). Returns L.width.
- Value curve: value = final · e4(pr(tv, t0, tLand)), with tLand = the measured onset of the spoken number (design_system 7).
